_comment: OPERATOR-OWNED. Documents GlowMap's revenue model and patient-contact policy. Builder reads this for context; never edits it.
_revenue_note: Revenue is earned exclusively from FLAT ADVERTISING PLACEMENT subscriptions sold to clinics. GlowMap never charges, meters, or receives any per-patient, per-inquiry, or per-lead fee. Per-patient referral fees raise Florida Patient Brokering Act / anti-kickback concerns; flat advertising placement does not.
_contact_note: The 'Get a quote' / inquiry affordance is a FREE feature for patients and clinics. Patient inquiries are forwarded directly to the clinic (via booking_url, phone, or free CRM forwarding). GlowMap does not sell, meter, or monetize individual inquiries. No billable lead ledger exists.
_routing_note: Routing order: (1) booking_url if present, (2) phone, (3) free inquiry form forwarded to clinic. Never to a lead-billing intermediary.

placement_subscription._checkout_note: Checkout is hosted by Bonalta Payments (external, gated). No payment card data is collected on or processed by GlowMap pages.
benefits: featured listing pinned to top of page
placement_subscription._slot_cap_note: Maximum featured listings per page. Prevents pages going all-paid. Operator-configurable in config/thresholds.json completeness.max_featured_per_page.

campaigns_upsell._trigger_note: When a clinic buys placement, flag campaigns_prospect=true and route to the Bonalta Campaigns CRM pipeline. NOT triggered by lead count.

evaluator_signals._note: The evaluator's 'qualified_leads_month' and 'lead_to_consult_rate' are PERFORMANCE SIGNALS only — they measure whether the directory is generating value that justifies build spend. They do NOT represent billable amounts or a per-lead revenue mechanism.
